quests.title: Overstretched

dialogue.t: *sigh* If only we had more men, there'd be no issue.
I'd happily go and clear them out — except, I worry that if I left my post here, some other monsters would seize the chance to ambush passers-by. I feel so helpless, stuck here all day...
Can you go and sort out the monsters over there for me? It would free me up to concentrate on other matters...
Thanks for helping clear out the monsters. I am sorry to have to ask you — I know it should be my job, I just really need your help...
*sigh* If only we had more men, there'd be no issue.
Thanks for helping clear out the monsters. I am sorry to have to ask you — I know it should be my job, I just really need your help...
*sigh* If only we had more men, there'd be no issue.
I can't cope...
Hmm? Who goes there? All who wish to cross this bridge are subject to interrogation, those are the rules.
That said... Just look at what you're wearing! You're definitely not someone I need to worry about...
Why? Think about it — criminals would want to dress as discreetly as possible, no? You, on the other hand, are dressed most ostentatiously indeed.
What are you doing here?
I am the Millelith responsible for this zone. This is a major thoroughfare to Dihua Marsh. Merchants and tourists all pass this way, so I'm stationed here to stand guard.

Just the other day, I discovered a group of monsters nearby... It appears they've set up a camp, and although they haven't made a move yet it's definitely a safety risk. I need to keep an eye on them.
I'd happily go and clear them out... except, I worry that if I left my post here, some other monsters would seize the chance to ambush passers-by. I feel so helpless, stuck here all day...
Seriously? All of them? That's... fantastic!
This was a huge help. I am sorry I had to ask you — it should have been my job, but you ended up doing it all for me...
Ugh, I don't know what the higher-ups are thinking, they really should have sent some more people by now. This zone is far too big for only one person...
They will be getting a full report on this situation as soon as I have the opportunity.
You have my thanks. Please take these for your trouble.

They will be getting a full report on this situation as soon as I have the opportunity.
You have my thanks. Please take these for your trouble.
How is it coming along?

dialogue.sit: I have dealt with the monsters.

dialogue.t: Thank you, it's a huge help. I am sorry I had to ask you — it should have been my job, but you ended up doing it all for me...
...There's no point you trying to play it down, you're covered in dust, which I'm sure is from a tooth-and-nail battle with the monsters.
Ugh, I don't know what the higher-ups are thinking, they really should have sent some more people by now. This zone is far too big for only one person...
It may be just a couple of bridges, but so much human traffic comes through here every day. If anything were to happen here, it would be catastrophic...
The higher-ups will be getting a full report on this situation as soon as I have the opportunity.
You have my thanks. Please take these for your trouble.

quests.description: Millelith Qiaoxi is tasked with guarding a major thoroughfare to Dihua Marsh. But he thinks this mammoth task is too much for one person…
